profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at The Hillman Group
profile.summary:
20 years ago, I thought learning to code was unattainable. Like trying to drink the ocean with a spoon.

Today, I am a Technical Lead working with an incredible team of people. I am obsessively committed to creating clean and elegant solutions for complex problems. I've spent my career working on dynamic, data-intensive, multi-tiered financial applications that must be fast and accurate. 

I'm a full-stack developer trained in UX design, and specializing in usability. My working life began in customer service, and that background taught me that usability is about people, not technology. I strive to delight my users with a carefully thought out design that anticipates their needs. It's challenging, and I love it. 

Over the years, I have learned many new languages, frameworks, and tools. Technology changes rapidly, but one thing is constant: there will always be more to learn. 

I'm still trying to drink the ocean.

positions.title: Senior Technical Lead
positions.description:
Formerly Comprehensive Software Systems (CSS)

• Guide the technical vision for the team's functional areas
• Bridge communication between stakeholders and engineers
• Act as a solution architect for new products and enhancements
• Mentor, empower and advocate for members of my team

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Formerly Comprehensive Software Systems (CSS)

• Managed the entire software development life cycle, from start to finish
• Led design sessions and code reviews, and created new technical standards
• Enhanced and maintained critical system frameworks and platforms
• Worked in close partnership with cross-functional teams and management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created and maintained data-intensive, back-end services
• Designed and implemented responsive and feature-rich user interfaces
• Read/update complex data scenarios with SQL stored procedures, functions and views 
• Work with business owners to analyze and define system requirements

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description: • Coordinated communication between customers and staff, and managed support tickets
